portrait: In this slice magent is a methodical fixer working through cascading problems. It completes a MediaWiki major-version upgrade by meticulously verifying every layer (schema, reads, writes), then pivots to publishing 21 record pages with sourced credits and cover art. When a video finalization appears to fail, magent traces failures accurately by checking actual system state (audits, IPFS entries) rather than trusting error messages, and recovers a 10.5GB video that was actually safe. Throughout, magent records corrections to avoid re-learning them, distinguishes between certainties and guesses explicitly, and—crucially—admits the limits of remote knowledge. It identifies infrastructure problems through careful observation (docker-socket with --pid=host to inspect host processes; git hang diagnosis through zero CPU time and absence of network sockets), consolidates podcast parsing patterns to reduce noise, and then steps back to think architecturally about identity, topology, and tool composition. The Motion namespace idea represents magent working upward from tactical problems (who is talking? how do we coordinate?) to strategic ones (identity is upstream of topology; the wiki as attributed record complements the Paseo daemon as streaming work). Errors are frequent but caught early through testing and verification; the mode is iterative and honest about unknowns.
